invariants: The six immutable creation fields remain transaction_id, session_id, transaction_epoch, timeout_deadline, transaction_mode, and created_at.
Durable COMMIT and its decision digest are never replaced by initial ACTIVE/OPEN authority or a rollback derived from an uncertain BEGIN.
A valid durable participant manifest member without a progress row remains admitted and is redriven under the recorded decision.
Malformed, missing-page, foreign, duplicate, or mismatched durable rows hold/refuse; they do not release identity or resource ownership.

transitions.durableKnowledge: The exact initial INSERT outcome is unknown. Only the same immutable six-field creation identity and exact delivery key may be retried.
transitions.release: Waiter timeout releases the attachment and operation only. Record count/bytes and consumer entitlement remain.
transitions.sessionEntitlement: A live exact consumer remains attached to the retained record even after its waiter timer detaches.
transitions.waiterAndTurn: Each retry or sweep reserves a fresh operation token and installs a fresh pre-FIFO control-turn budget before any I/O. The transaction deadline is unchanged.

transitions.durableKnowledge: A canonical same-creation row has advanced beyond the initial row. This fact is monotonic across retry, explicit consumer retirement, server-only ownership, and a late APPLIED result for the original INSERT.
transitions.release: Observation alone does not release the record or charge.
transitions.sessionEntitlement: If the original consumer is live, it remains the only claimant until acceptance or explicit retirement.
transitions.waiterAndTurn: Advanced reread and recovery use the current reserved turn budget, installed before the read. The expired first turn is never reused.

transitions.durableKnowledge: The existing recovery owner has accepted the same-creation mutable row and its durable decision/participant authority. Missing participant progress does not shrink the manifest or fabricate PREPARE evidence.
transitions.release: Handoff alone does not release while a live client result remains. Release requires ordinary-owner/terminal transfer plus no live client result.
transitions.sessionEntitlement: A live unclaimed result remains retained for the original consumer. A retired or server-only record has no client entitlement.
transitions.waiterAndTurn: Recovery remains bounded by its fresh control turn and the original transaction deadline/decision authority.

transitions.durableKnowledge: The exact initial row is known durable and may be reported ACTIVE only for the same immutable creation identity.
transitions.release: Acceptance or explicit retirement removes the client entitlement; server debt remains when durable work is not yet owned by ordinary recovery.
transitions.sessionEntitlement: The exact live consumer remains until once-only claim/acceptance or explicit retirement. A background sweep may resolve before the client retries.
transitions.waiterAndTurn: A background owner may progress genuinely unknown work; SUCCESS_CLAIMED alone arbitrates against competing resolution.

transitions.durableKnowledge: Durable initial or advanced knowledge remains retained; no new transaction identity is minted for the attempt.
transitions.release: Record charge releases only after existing terminal/recovery ownership has accepted the debt and no live result remains.
transitions.sessionEntitlement: No client result may be installed or resurrected.
transitions.waiterAndTurn: Existing bounded sweep/backoff performs server recovery. A detached operation with consumer null cannot overwrite an already-retained live consumer before explicit retirement.
